title: What Are You Doing?
description: Ask and say what is happening at the present moment.
objectives: Ask and say what is happening at the present moment.

stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to ask and say what is happening at the present moment. The central language is present continuous for actions now. It belongs to the practical context of free time & abilities. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A1, keep the message short and concrete. One clear sentence is enough before the other person responds. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

blocks.english: What are you doing right now?
blocks.explanation: Use this model to begin the what are you doing? exchange.
This what are you doing? model adds a different detail or response.

blocks.english: What do you like to do?
blocks.explanation: Use this question or response to keep the what are you doing? exchange moving.

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “What are you doing right now?” and “I'm reading a new book.” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: present continuous for actions now.
